groups.instructions: Read the following report about eating habits. Then choose the correct ending for each sentence. There is one extra ending in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/
groups.context:
Eating out in Westford

A survey by the Westford city council shows how eating habits are changing. In 2015, families in Westford ate out on average twice a month. In 2025 this figure had risen to five times a month.

Fast food is the most popular choice, but its share is falling. In 2015, 70 per cent of meals eaten out were fast food; by 2025 this had dropped to 55 per cent. Restaurants serving vegetarian and healthy food have become much more popular, especially among people under 30.

The council expects that by 2030 more than half of all meals eaten out will be delivered to people's homes through mobile apps, rather than eaten in restaurants.

wordBank.text: … was carried out by the city council.
… will probably be delivered to homes.
… are especially popular with people under 30.

groups.title: Listening
groups.instructions: You are going to listen to a dialogue between a radio presenter and a woman who is a firefighter. For questions 41-46 decide which of the choices A, B, C, D or E is the correct answer. You have 45 seconds to look through the questions before you listen. You will listen twice only, so listen carefully. /6 x 2 = 12 points/
groups.context:
Presenter: Today I'm talking to Maria Lopez, one of the first women firefighters in her city. Maria, welcome.
Maria: Thanks for having me.
Presenter: How long have you been a firefighter?
Maria: Eleven years now. Before that I was a PE teacher at a secondary school.
Presenter: Why did you change jobs?
Maria: When I was twenty-six, there was a fire in my apartment building. The firefighters carried an old man down from the sixth floor. I watched them and thought, 'That's what I want to do.'
Presenter: Was the training difficult?
Maria: Very. It lasted eight months. The physical tests were hard, but the hardest part was learning to stay calm in smoke and darkness. They train you to think clearly when everything around you is chaos.
Presenter: Can you tell us about a day you'll never forget?
Maria: Two years ago, a fire started in a hotel kitchen. About ninety guests were inside. We got everyone out in twenty minutes, and nobody was injured. The hotel manager told us the alarm system had been checked only the week before, which helped a lot.
Presenter: What advice do you have for listeners?
Maria: Check your smoke alarm every month. It costs almost nothing, and it can save your family's life.

questions.prompt: The train leaves ___ platform 4 ___ 10:15.
questions.explanation: Хөдлөх цэгийг “from” (…-аас), цагийн тодорхой агшныг “at” угтвар үгээр илэрхийлдэг тул “from / at”: галт тэрэг “platform 4”-өөс 10:15-д хөдөлнө.

questions.prompt: My best friend ___ three languages.
questions.explanation: Хэдэн хэл мэддэг нь байнгын чадвар, баримт тул одоо энгийн цаг хэрэглэнэ; “he”, “she”-тэй адил “My best friend” өгүүлэгдэхүүнд үйл үг “-s” авч “speaks” болно.

questions.prompt: Last weekend we ___ a film about whales.
questions.explanation: “Last weekend” нь өнгөрсөнд дууссан тодорхой хугацаа тул өнгөрсөн энгийн цагийн “-ed” дагавартай “watched” хэрэглэнэ; “have watched” өнгөрсөн тодорхой цагтай хамт хэрэглэгддэггүй.

questions.prompt: I can't find my wallet. I think I ___ it.
questions.explanation: Түрийвч алга болсны үр дагавар одоо мэдрэгдэж байгаа (“I can't find my wallet”) тул одоо төгссөн цаг; “I”-тэй “has” биш “have” ордог тул “have lost”.

questions.prompt: I'm ___ my grandparents this weekend. Would you like ___ with me?
questions.explanation: Эмээ өвөө дээрээ очихоор аль хэдийн товлосон тул “I'm visiting” гэж одоо үргэлжилж буй цагийг ирээдүйн утгаар хэрэглэж, “Would you like”-ийн дараа “to come” орно: “visiting / to come”.

questions.prompt: Do you know the girl ___ is talking to the teacher?
questions.explanation: “the girl” хүн тул түүнийг тодотгох “is talking to the teacher” хэсэг “who” харьцангуй төлөөний үгээр эхэлнэ; “which” нь амьтан, юманд, “whose” эзэмшилд хэрэглэгддэг.

questions.prompt: Sorry, I ___ hear you. Can you repeat that?
questions.explanation: “Can you repeat that?” гэж дахин хэлүүлэх гэж байгаа нь сонсож чадахгүй байгааг харуулна, тиймээс чадварыг үгүйсгэсэн “can't”; “mustn't” хориг, “needn't” шаардлагагүй гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: I'd like you ___ me with this box.
questions.explanation: “I'd like” (“would like”) нь хүний дараа “to” + үйл үг авдаг тул “I'd like you to help me” (надад туслаасай гэж хүсэж байна); “I'd like you help” гэж хэлэхгүй.

questions.prompt: The Naadam festival ___ every July.
questions.explanation: Наадам зохион байгуулагддаг зүйл тул “holds” биш үйлдэгдэх хэв “is held” (болдог, зохиогддог) хэрэгтэй; “every July” нь жил бүр давтагдах үйлийг заадаг тул одоо энгийн цаг.

questions.prompt: My new phone is ___ than my old one.
questions.explanation: “than my old one” гэж хоёр утсыг харьцуулж байгаа тул “fast”-ийн харьцуулах зэрэг “faster”-ийг “much” үгээр онцолж “much faster” гэнэ; “more fast”, “fastly” гэсэн хэлбэр байхгүй.

questions.prompt: If they ___ now, they ___ the start of the concert.
questions.explanation: Концертын эхлэлд амжих эсэх нь одоо (“now”) гарахаас шууд хамаарах бодит нөхцөл (1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр); ийм үед “if” хэсэгт “will” ордоггүй, харин үр дүнд ордог тул “leave / will catch”.

questions.prompt: She asked me whether I ___ coffee.
questions.explanation: “whether” нь тийм, үгүй асуултыг шууд бус ярианд дамжуулдаг бөгөөд “asked” өнгөрсөн цагт байгаа тул “Do you like coffee?” нь “whether I liked coffee” болно.

questions.prompt: After university, he started a successful ___ in banking.
questions.explanation: “a successful career in banking” гэдэг нь банкны салбарт амжилттай ажлын гараа гэсэн утга; “profit” ашиг, “salary” цалин, “employer” ажил олгогч тул “started a successful” гэсэнтэй зохицохгүй.

questions.prompt: Ganaa is very ___; she never gets angry when people are slow.
questions.explanation: “she never gets angry when people are slow” (бусад удаан байхад ч хэзээ ч уурладаггүй) гэсэн нь Ганааг “patient” буюу тэвчээртэй гэдгийг харуулна; “impatient” эсрэг утгатай.

questions.prompt: Last summer we joined a two-week ___ to explore the caves of the Altai mountains.
questions.explanation: Агуйг судлахаар (“to explore the caves”) хоёр долоо хоног явсан бэлтгэлтэй аяллыг “expedition” гэдэг; “picnic”, “walk” нь богино зугаалга, “lesson” хичээл.

questions.prompt: I'm not ___ about the answer. Let me check it again.
questions.explanation: “Let me check it again” гэсэн нь хариултдаа итгэлгүй байгааг харуулна; “not sure about something” (…-д итгэлтэй биш) тогтсон хэллэг тул “sure”.

questions.prompt: After months without rain, the ___ destroyed all the crops.
questions.explanation: “After months without rain” гэсэн нь удаан үргэлжилсэн гангийн шинж тул “drought” (ган); “famine” нь ургац алдсаны дараа үүсдэг өлсгөлөн, “flood” үер.

questions.prompt: The teacher ___ the students for their excellent work.
questions.explanation: “for their excellent work” (маш сайн ажилласных нь төлөө) гэсэн нь эерэг үнэлгээ тул “praised” (магтсан); “blamed”, “punished” сөрөг утгатай, “complained” нь “about” шаарддаг.

questions.prompt: Cereals such as rice, wheat and barley are important <u>crops</u> in Asia.
questions.explanation: “crops” нь хүнсэнд зориулж тариалдаг ургамал гэсэн утгатай тул “plants grown for food”; өгүүлбэрт “rice, wheat and barley” гэж жишээ дурдсан.

questions.prompt: The cake has three main <u>ingredients</u>: flour, eggs and sugar.
options: foods used to make a dish
answers: foods used to make a dish
questions.answerDisplay: foods used to make a dish
questions.explanation: “ingredients” нь хоол хийхэд орох орц гэсэн утгатай: “flour, eggs and sugar” нь бялуу хийхэд хэрэглэдэг хүнс тул “foods used to make a dish”; “recipes” нь жор.

questions.prompt: It's <u>freezing</u> today. Wear your warmest coat.
questions.explanation: “Wear your warmest coat” гэж хамгийн дулаан пальтогоо өмс гэсэн нь цаг агаар “freezing” (тэсгим хүйтэн) буюу “very cold” болохыг харуулна.

questions.prompt: Could you switch ___ the light? It's getting dark.
questions.explanation: “It's getting dark” (харанхуй болж байна) гэсэн тул гэрлээ асаахыг хүсэж байна: “switch on” (асаах); “switch off” нь унтраах гэсэн эсрэг утгатай.

questions.prompt: I need to cut ___ on sugar; my doctor says I eat too much.
questions.explanation: “my doctor says I eat too much” гэсэн тул чихрийн хэрэглээгээ багасгах хэрэгтэй: “cut down on something” нь ямар нэг зүйлийн хэрэглээг багасгах гэсэн хэлц үйл үг.

questions.prompt: Please don't throw ___ these old newspapers; I want to recycle them.
questions.explanation: “throw away” нь хаях гэсэн утгатай; “I want to recycle them” (дахин боловсруулахыг хүсэж байна) учир хуучин сонинуудыг битгий хая гэж байна.

questions.prompt: We ran ___ of milk, so I had black coffee.
questions.explanation: “run out of something” нь ямар нэг зүйл дуусах гэсэн хэлц үйл үг: сүү дууссан тул “so I had black coffee” (сүүгүй хар кофе уусан).

questions.prompt: ___ is someone whose job is to cook food in a restaurant.
questions.explanation: Ресторанд мэргэжлийн түвшинд хоол хийдэг хүнийг “A chef” (тогооч) гэнэ; “A waiter” зөөгч, “A baker” талх нарийн боов хийгч, “A butcher” махны худалдагч.

questions.prompt: ___ is someone who sells meat in a shop.
questions.explanation: Дэлгүүрт мах зардаг хүн бол “A butcher” (махны худалдагч, яргачин); “A grocer” хүнсний бараа зардаг, “A fisherman” загасчин, “A cook” тогооч.

questions.prompt: Spaghetti with tomato sauce.
questions.explanation: “Spaghetti with tomato sauce” нь хоолны нэр тул “What's your favourite dish?” (хамгийн дуртай хоол чинь юу вэ) гэсэн асуулт; “Who cooks?” хүн, “When do you eat?” цаг асууна.

questions.prompt: Every Saturday morning.
options: Who do you go fishing with?
How often do you go fishing?
answers: How often do you go fishing?
questions.answerDisplay: How often do you go fishing?
questions.explanation: “Every Saturday morning” (Бямба гараг бүрийн өглөө) нь давтамжийг заадаг тул “How often do you go fishing?”; “Where”, “Who … with” нь газар, хамт явах хүнийг асууна.

questions.prompt: It's about three kilometres.
options: How far is the station from here?
answers: How far is the station from here?
questions.answerDisplay: How far is the station from here?
questions.explanation: “about three kilometres” нь зай тул зайг асуудаг “How far is the station from here?” гэсэн асуулт; “How long does it take?” нь хугацаа асууна.

questions.prompt: Not too bad. A bit tired.
questions.explanation: “Not too bad. A bit tired.” (тийм ч муу биш, жаахан ядарсан) гэж бие сэтгэлийн байдлаа хэлсэн тул “How are you feeling?” (бие чинь ямар байна) гэж асуусан.

questions.prompt: Leather, I think.
options: Where did you buy your shoes?
What are your shoes made of?
answers: What are your shoes made of?
questions.answerDisplay: What are your shoes made of?
questions.explanation: “Leather” (арьс) нь материал тул “What are your shoes made of?” гэж гутал юугаар хийгдснийг асуусан; “What size …?” хэмжээ, “How much …?” үнэ асууна.

questions.prompt: According to the text, at first chocolate was
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
questions.explanation: 1-р догол мөрөнд “for most of its history it was not eaten at all. It was drunk” гэж бичсэн тул шоколад анх “a drink” буюу ундаа байсан.

questions.prompt: The drink of the Maya and Aztecs was
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
questions.explanation: 2-р догол мөрөнд Майя, Ацтекүүдийн ундааг “usually cold, bitter and often mixed with chilli pepper” гэжээ; чинжүүтэй гэдэг нь халуун ногоотой гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: Cacao seeds were used
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
questions.explanation: “It was so valuable that cacao seeds were used as money” гэж бичсэн; атга үрээр туулай эсвэл сагс жимс худалдаж авч болдог байжээ.

questions.prompt: The Spanish
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
options: added sugar and honey to the drink.
answers: added sugar and honey to the drink.
questions.answerDisplay: added sugar and honey to the drink.
questions.explanation: 3-р догол мөрөнд “The Spanish added sugar and honey to make the drink sweet” гэжээ; испаничууд какаог Европт авчирсан ч Испанид тариагүй.

questions.prompt: Daniel Peter
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
options: produced the first chocolate bar in 1847.
questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөрөнд “a Swiss chocolate maker, Daniel Peter, added milk and created milk chocolate” гэсэн; анхны шоколадан хавтанг харин 1847 онд Британийн компани хийжээ.

questions.prompt: What does "it" in paragraph 4 refer to?
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
questions.explanation: “Factories made chocolate cheaper, and for the first time ordinary people could enjoy it” гэсэнд энгийн хүмүүсийн таашаах болсон зүйл нь хямдарсан “chocolate” тул “it” үүнийг заана.

questions.prompt: Why do some companies sell 'fair trade' chocolate?
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
options: To give farmers a better price.
answers: To give farmers a better price.
questions.answerDisplay: To give farmers a better price.
questions.explanation: Сүүлийн догол мөрөнд “fair trade” шоколад нь “guarantees farmers a better price for their beans” гэж бичсэн; ядуу тариаланчдад илүү шударга үнэ олгох зорилготой.

questions.prompt: Which statement is TRUE according to the text?
questions.passage: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
options: Chocolate bars are more than 3,000 years old.
Most cacao today is grown in West Africa.
Only poor people drank chocolate in the past.
Milk chocolate was invented in Britain.
Chocolate houses were opened in Central America.
answers: Most cacao today is grown in West Africa.
questions.answerDisplay: Most cacao today is grown in West Africa.
questions.explanation: Сүүлийн догол мөрөнд “Today, most of the world's cacao is grown in West Africa” гэжээ; бусад өгүүлбэр эхтэй зөрчилддөг, жишээ нь сүүтэй шоколадыг Швейцарийн хүн бүтээсэн.

questions.prompt: If you eat too much sugar, …
options: … what would we like to drink.
… I would open a small restaurant.
… as soon as the results arrive.
… what we would like to drink.
questions.explanation: Хэт их чихэр идэхийн үр дагаврыг ерөнхий үнэн байдлаар хэлж байгаа тул “If you eat too much sugar” гэсний дараа боломж заасан “can” бүхий “… you can damage your teeth” орно.

questions.prompt: If I could cook well, …
options: … what would we like to drink.
… I would open a small restaurant.
… as soon as the results arrive.
… what we would like to drink.
answers: … I would open a small restaurant.
questions.answerDisplay: 3. … I would open a small restaurant.
questions.explanation: Сайн хоол хийж чаддаггүй хүний мөрөөдөл тул “If I could cook well” нь 2-р төрлийн нөхцөл бөгөөд гол хэсэг “… I would open a small restaurant” (жижиг ресторан нээх байсан) болно.

questions.prompt: She whispered so that …
options: … what would we like to drink.
… I would open a small restaurant.
… as soon as the results arrive.
… what we would like to drink.
questions.explanation: Шивнэсэн шалтгаан нь хүүхдийг сэрээхгүй байх зорилго тул “so that”-ийн араас “would”-ийн үгүйсгэл орно: “She whispered so that … she wouldn't wake the baby”.

questions.prompt: The waiter asked us …
options: … what would we like to drink.
… I would open a small restaurant.
… as soon as the results arrive.
… what we would like to drink.
answers: … what we would like to drink.
questions.answerDisplay: 6. … what we would like to drink.
questions.explanation: Зөөгчийн асуултыг “asked us” гэж дамжуулахад үгийн дараалал хүүрнэх өгүүлбэрийнх болдог: “… what we would like to drink”; “what would we like to drink” асуултын дарааллаа хадгалсан тул буруу.

questions.prompt: I'll phone you …
options: … what would we like to drink.
… I would open a small restaurant.
… as soon as the results arrive.
… what we would like to drink.
answers: … as soon as the results arrive.
questions.answerDisplay: 4. … as soon as the results arrive.
questions.explanation: “as soon as” (…-нгуут, …мөнд) нь ирээдүйн тухай ярихад ч одоо энгийн цаг авдаг: “I'll phone you … as soon as the results arrive” (хариу ирэнгүүт залгана).

questions.prompt: 'Are you ready to order?'
questions.explanation: Зөөгч “Are you ready to order?” гэж захиалга авахад “Yes, I'll have the soup, please.” гэж юу захиалахаа хэлнэ; “I'll have …” нь хоол захиалах түгээмэл хэллэг.

questions.prompt: 'How would you like to pay?'
questions.explanation: “How would you like to pay?” нь төлбөрийн хэлбэрийг асуудаг тул “By card, please.” (картаар төлье) гэж хариулна; “Twenty minutes ago.” нь цаг хугацаа заана.

questions.prompt: 'Is this seat free?'
questions.explanation: “Is this seat free?” гэсэн асуултад суудал завгүй гэдгийг эелдгээр “Sorry, my friend is sitting there.” (уучлаарай, найз маань сууж байгаа) гэж хэлнэ.

questions.prompt: 'Would you like dessert?'
questions.explanation: “Would you like dessert?” гэж амттан санал болгоход татгалзахдаа “No, thanks. I'm full.” (баярлалаа, цадсан) гэж хариулна.

questions.prompt: 'How was your meal?'
questions.explanation: “How was your meal?” гэж хоол ямар байсныг асуухад “Delicious, thank you.” (амттай байлаа, баярлалаа) гэж үнэлгээ өгнө.

questions.prompt: Gap a)
questions.explanation: Өглөөний цайгаа урьд оройноос төлөвлөдөг, “they like lists and always know where their keys are” гэсэн хүмүүс “organized” (цэгцтэй, зохион байгуулалттай).

questions.prompt: Gap b)
questions.explanation: Өглөөний цайгаа алгасаж зөвхөн кофе барьж гардаг хүмүүс “never seem to have enough time” буюу үргэлж цаг хүрэлцдэггүй тул “busy” (завгүй).

questions.prompt: Gap c)
questions.explanation: Жимс, тараг, үр тариа иддэг, “care about what they put into their bodies” (биедээ юу оруулж байгаагаа анхаардаг) хүмүүс “healthy” (эрүүл) хооллодог.

questions.prompt: Gap d)
questions.explanation: Сүүтэй цай, боорцог гэх мэт эмээ өвөөгийнхөө иддэг хоолыг иддэг, “respect old customs” (хуучин ёс заншлаа хүндэлдэг) хүмүүс “traditional” (уламжлалт).

questions.prompt: Gap e)
questions.explanation: Амралтын өдөр удаан, тайван цайлдаг хүмүүс “don't worry about time” буюу цаг хугацаанд санаа зовдоггүй тул “relaxed” (тайван, сэтгэл амар); “shy” (ичимхий) энэ эхэд тохирох зайгүй.

questions.prompt: Between 2015 and 2025, the number of times families ate out …
options: … was carried out by the city council.
… will probably be delivered to homes.
… are especially popular with people under 30.
questions.explanation: Гэр бүлүүд 2015 онд сард хоёр удаа гадуур хооллодог байсан бол 2025 онд энэ тоо “had risen to five times a month” болсон; 5 нь 2-ын хоёр дахин болох 4-өөс их тул “… more than doubled”.

questions.prompt: The share of fast food …
options: … was carried out by the city council.
… will probably be delivered to homes.
… are especially popular with people under 30.
questions.explanation: Түргэн хоолны хувь 2015 онд “70 per cent” байсан бол 2025 онд “had dropped to 55 per cent” болсон тул “… fell from 70 to 55 per cent”; “rose to 70 per cent” нь эсрэгээрээ.

questions.prompt: Healthy and vegetarian restaurants …
options: … was carried out by the city council.
… will probably be delivered to homes.
… are especially popular with people under 30.
answers: … are especially popular with people under 30.
questions.answerDisplay: 5. … are especially popular with people under 30.
questions.explanation: Тайланд вегетариан, эрүүл хоолны ресторанууд “have become much more popular, especially among people under 30” гэсэн тул “… are especially popular with people under 30”.

questions.prompt: By 2030, most meals eaten out …
options: … was carried out by the city council.
… will probably be delivered to homes.
… are especially popular with people under 30.
answers: … will probably be delivered to homes.
questions.answerDisplay: 3. … will probably be delivered to homes.
questions.explanation: Зөвлөл 2030 он гэхэд “more than half of all meals eaten out will be delivered to people's homes” гэж хүлээж байгаа тул “… will probably be delivered to homes”.

questions.prompt: The survey …
options: … was carried out by the city council.
… will probably be delivered to homes.
… are especially popular with people under 30.
answers: … was carried out by the city council.
questions.answerDisplay: 1. … was carried out by the city council.
questions.explanation: Тайлан “A survey by the Westford city council” гэж эхэлдэг тул судалгааг хотын зөвлөл явуулсан: “The survey … was carried out by the city council”.

questions.prompt: Before becoming a firefighter, Maria was
questions.explanation: Мариа “Before that I was a PE teacher at a secondary school” гэж хэлсэн тул гал сөнөөгч болохоосоо өмнө “a PE teacher” (биеийн тамирын багш) байжээ.

questions.prompt: Maria decided to become a firefighter after
options: a fire in her apartment building.
answers: a fire in her apartment building.
questions.answerDisplay: a fire in her apartment building.
questions.explanation: Мариа “When I was twenty-six, there was a fire in my apartment building” гэж ярьсан; гал сөнөөгчид өвгөнийг аварч байхыг хараад энэ ажлыг сонгосон.

questions.prompt: Maria's training lasted
questions.explanation: Сургалтын тухай Мариа “Very. It lasted eight months” гэсэн тул “eight months”; “eleven years” бол түүний гал сөнөөгчөөр ажилласан хугацаа.

questions.prompt: According to Maria, the hardest part of the training was
options: learning to stay calm in smoke and darkness.
answers: learning to stay calm in smoke and darkness.
questions.answerDisplay: learning to stay calm in smoke and darkness.
questions.explanation: Мариа “The physical tests were hard, but the hardest part was learning to stay calm in smoke and darkness” гэжээ; биеийн тамирын шалгалт хэцүү байсан ч хамгийн хэцүү нь биш.

questions.prompt: In the hotel fire,
options: everyone got out in twenty minutes and nobody was hurt.
answers: everyone got out in twenty minutes and nobody was hurt.
questions.answerDisplay: everyone got out in twenty minutes and nobody was hurt.
questions.explanation: Зочид буудлын галын тухай Мариа “We got everyone out in twenty minutes, and nobody was injured” гэсэн; “injured” нь “hurt” буюу гэмтсэн гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: Maria advises listeners to
options: check their smoke alarm every month.
stay only in hotels with alarms.
answers: check their smoke alarm every month.
questions.answerDisplay: check their smoke alarm every month.
questions.explanation: Сонсогчдод өгсөн зөвлөгөө нь “Check your smoke alarm every month” байсан бөгөөд энэ нь “can save your family's life” (гэр бүлийнхээ амийг аварч болно) гэжээ.

passages.title: From Bitter Drink to Sweet Bar
passages.text:
Chocolate is one of the most popular foods in the world, but for most of its history it was not eaten at all. It was drunk. Chocolate comes from the seeds of the cacao tree, which grows in hot, wet regions near the equator. More than three thousand years ago, people in Central America were already growing cacao and making a drink from its seeds.

For the Maya and later the Aztecs, this drink was very different from modern hot chocolate. It was usually cold, bitter and often mixed with chilli pepper. It was so valuable that cacao seeds were used as money: with a handful of seeds, a person could buy a rabbit or a basket of fruit. Only rich and important people could drink chocolate regularly.

In the sixteenth century, Spanish explorers brought cacao back to Europe. The Spanish added sugar and honey to make the drink sweet, and it soon became fashionable among wealthy Europeans. Chocolate houses, similar to coffee shops, opened in London and other cities.

Solid chocolate came much later. In 1847 a British company produced the first chocolate bar by mixing cocoa powder, sugar and melted cocoa butter. Then, in 1875, a Swiss chocolate maker, Daniel Peter, added milk and created milk chocolate. Factories made chocolate cheaper, and for the first time ordinary people could enjoy **it**.

Today, most of the world's cacao is grown in West Africa, especially in Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana. Many farmers there are very poor and earn only a small part of the price we pay for a chocolate bar. For this reason, some companies now sell 'fair trade' chocolate, which guarantees farmers a better price for their beans.

sourceNote: 2022–2026 оны жишиг эх нь албан БҮТ-ийн эх биш, нийтэд нээлттэй хуулбар; 2018–2020 оны албан хувилбарын бүтцийг баримталсан.
